_note: Beuteordnung der Welten (docs/BEUTEORDNUNG.de.md, read by src/progress/reward_rules.gd). Life in LP (1 heart = 2 LP). depth T = floor + 10 x chapters the hero already finished. dmg: hit size per depth (steps: T up to `to` -> lp; past the last step 1 + floor((T-1)/3)); every hit on the hero is its base damage x dmg(T); bosses keep their double base. cap_hits: the life cap is cap_hits x dmg(T). heal_hits: a heal heart heals heal_hits x dmg(T). life_heart: guardian = LP of a floor or mini guardian (not the final boss); puzzle = ceil(T / 2) + (tier - 3) from tier 3 on. chapter_hp: monster and boss HP x (1 + chapter_hp x chapters the hero finished). loot value W = T + tier_step x (tier - 1); gold = gold_base + gold_per_value x W; min_rarity by W (first band whose `to` >= W). rarity_weights: normal rolls, [floor 1, floor 10] per rarity (deeper = floor 10). tiers: per puzzle tier the chest's parts: guaranteed = pieces of at least the min rarity (own = of the hero's class), extra = plain chest rolls, heal = heal hearts, rune = chance of one rune stone, stones = consumables, clean = guaranteed pieces never cursed, up_one = one guaranteed piece a rarity higher (at most epic). tier_share: chance per tier of a puzzle room by floor band. legendary: chance that the best piece of a puzzle chest turns legendary by floor (of the chapter) and tier; sure = clean; the rest roll a curse chance in curse_range. special: chest values of rooms that count as a tier (secret, hidden), the vault, guardians and the final boss. blood: the path costs (thorn hearts of heart_hits x dmg) and the tier shift per path. pact / sacrifice: the price rooms of the hell.
